marquee: One shared display, everyone on their own account, one tap to switch.

1.title: One display. Every account. One tap.
1.lead: Everyone plays under their own Autodarts account, without signing in again and again.
points: Sessions stay ready in the background

2.title: Keeps itself going.
2.lead: Parked sessions are renewed in the background. If you like, the extension remembers a password and signs an account back in by itself.

3.title: Switch right on the board.
3.lead: In fullscreen or kiosk mode, a round button on the page opens the players in big tiles for a touch screen.
